description: Disable the semantic router. Every task is handled at a fixed default tier regardless of its shape, so we can measure what the router itself buys us.
status: declared; wired to the policy engine in P2
ledger_rows_carrying_this_label: Eight rows in benchmark/results/ledger.json carry variant v2-no-router, all dated 2026-08-03. They do not contradict the status above. The variant was a label score.py wrote onto a row and nothing upstream read, so no overlay drove them, and they sit inside the 172 rows of that date the changelog keeps as history rather than as the basis of any claim.
